entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: GOFO's label row, copied once on Beijing's clock and once on GOFO's: the sender still has the parcel.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.english: Electronic information about the goods has been received
entries.note: The platform's order row; the tracker writes the English row beside it at the same clock.

entries.wording: 到达收货点
entries.note: The platform's first scan at the forwarder, shown in the English the platform's other tenants give it.

entries.wording: 货物离开操作中心
Goods arrive at the receiving point at the Shenzhen warehouse
entries.note: The line's warehouse in Shenzhen taking the parcel in.

entries.wording: The goods have been dispatched from the Shenzhen warehouse
Domestic customs clearance completed
entries.note: China's export clearance done, before the flight: the parcel is not held.

entries.wording: 国内清关完成(Customs export clearance completed)
entries.note: The same export clearance in both languages.

entries.wording: Handed over to airline.
已交航(Package handed over to airline)
航班配载中(Loading in progress for flight)
预计…航班（Flight scheduled for …）
entries.note: The flight booked for the parcel, its day as month.day and in English read as an ellipsis. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 航班延误至…号飞（The flight has been delayed until the …）
entries.note: The booked flight put off to a later day, read as an ellipsis. No movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 航班已起飞,The flight has taken off from the origin
航班已起飞(Flight has taken off)
航班已抵达(Flight has arrived)
航班已到达,清关拆板中 The flight has arrived, customs clearance and unpacking are underway
entries.note: Landed, with the import clearance under way.

entries.wording: 拆板提货中（Deconsolidation & Pickup in Progress）
entries.note: The flight's pallets broken down and collected at the destination airport: not a collection by the recipient.

entries.wording: 清关中/Customs clearance in progress
目的地清关中(Customs clearance in progress at destination)
国外清关完成(Customs import clearance completed)
法国海关查验
entries.note: French customs inspecting the parcel; the tracker writes the English row beside it at the same clock.

entries.wording: French Customs inspection
清关放行，待交仓(Customs cleared,pending handover to local carrier)
entries.note: Released by customs, waiting for the hand-over to the delivery carrier.

entries.wording: 货物已清关完成, Import customs clearance complete
已交服务商(Handed over to local agent)
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivery carrier in the destination country.
